summary: DeepSeek-V4.1 and V4 tool calls keep parameters that omit the string attribute
details: When the model wrote a DSML tool-call parameter without its string="true|false" attribute, the parser dropped that parameter, so the client received the tool call without it (for example {"a": "x"} instead of {"a": "x", "n": 12}). A missing attribute is now treated like string="false": the value is parsed as JSON and otherwise kept as literal text, in streaming and non-streaming responses and in the Python and Rust parsers.
The change preserves the original author and code from vllm-project/vllm#56271.
